notes: The nominated span is standard NPDES cover-page authorization language identifying the receiving waters (San Juan River, segment 20.6.4.401) and the permitted facility address. It does not state numeric effluent limits, monitoring schedules or conditions, or semantics for missing or no-discharge reporting. Adjacent context places enforceable limits and monitoring requirements in Parts I–IV, not in this clause. Reasonable alternative readings of the authorization, segment designation, or facility location would not change which limit applies to a reported measurement, whether a monitoring requirement was applicable, or how to classify missing-evidence cases for Federal FY2025.
